paite: Unau ki-itna om zel hen.
heading: Pathian Deihlam Thuhilhna
english: Let brotherly love continue.

paite: Mikhualte tung ah itna suah ding mangngilh kei un; huchibang hih in khenkhat in theiloupi in angelte azintun uhi.
english: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.

paite: Hen a omte hen hi sam bang in theigige unla; gimthuakte sa a om sam na hih ziak un theigige un.
english: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them; and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.

paite: Mi tengteng lak ah kitenna pahtawi in om henla, lupna leng hihbuah louh in om hen; kingaite leh angkawmte tung a Pathian in vaihawm ding ahi.
english: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled: but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

paite: Na lungsim putdan uh dangka deihtakna pang lou hi hen; na thil neihsun tung uah lungkim un; amah mah in, "Bangchik mah in ka hon don lou kei ding a, pai leng ka hon paisan kei ding,” achi hi.
english: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.” Deuteronomy 31:6

paite: Huchi in hangsantak in, "Toupa hon panpihpa ahi, ka lau kei ding; mihing in bang ahon chih thei dia?" i chi uhi.
english: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?” Psalm 118:6-7

paite: Noute hon heu, Pathian thu hon hilhte, theigige unla, a-omdan ua thilsuakte ngaihtuah in a-omdan uh ching un.
heading: Heutute Thumanna
english: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.

paite: Jesu Khrist tuh zan, tuni leh tangtawn in angeingei in a-om gige hi.
english: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

paite: Kisinsakna tuamtuam leh thugin lamdangte mutleng in om kei un; lungtang hehpihna a hihkip a om ahoih ngal a, nek dingte bang a hihkip a om lou in; huchibang lam lungkhamte'n huaite ah phattuamna amu tuan kei uhi.
english: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by food, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.

paite: Eite'n maitam khat, biakbuk nasemte'n anek theihlouhna mun i nei hi.
english: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.

paite: Gan sisan, siampu lianpen in mun siangthou a khelhna a dia lan a alutpih zel luangte dainawl ah ahal uhi.
english: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp. Leviticus 16:27

paite: Huchi in Jesu in leng amah sisan mahmah a mite ahihsianthouna ding in kulh kongkhak polam ah ana thuakta hi.
english: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.

paite: Huchi in amah amuhsitna uh pu in dainawl ah akiang lam ah i paikhe ding uhi.
english: Let us therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.

paite: Hiai lai ah zaw khomun kip i nei ngal kei ua, kho hong om ding i zong uh ahi zaw hi.
english: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.

paite: Huchi in amah vang in phatna kithoihna Pathian kiang ah i lan gige ding uh, amin gupna mukte gah ahih ziak in.
english: Through him, then, let us offer up a sacrifice of praise to God Psalm 50:23 continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.

paite: Himahleh thil hihhoih leh thilphal mangngilh kei un; huai bang kithoihna tung ah Pathian alungkim mahmah hi.
english: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

paite: Nou hon heutute thu mang unla, athuthu un om un, anasepte uh tanchin gen nawn ding a, na khate uh ching a hon veng ahi uhi, lungkham kawm hilou in, kipaktak in semsak un; huchi lou in zaw nou a ding a khawk ahi zaw ding hi.
english: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy, and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.

paite: Hon thumsak un; bangkim a diktattak a om a, sia-le-pha theihna siangtak nei ka hi uh chih diktak in ka kithei uhi.
heading: Mangpha Khakna Thukhahte
english: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.

paite: Huan kintak a na kiang ua sawl nawn a ka omtheihna ding in, huai ding in ka hon ngen nawn sem hi.
english: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.

paite: Tu in, lemna Pathian, tangtawn thukhun sisan ziak a misi lak a kipan a, i Toupa Jesu, belamchingpa thupitak, kaithou nawnpa'n,
english: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,

paite: amitmuh a akipah lam peuhmah Jesu Khrist ziak in eimah a sem in, adeihlam hih ding in thil hoih chiteng lam ah nou hon hihkim hen; Jesu Khrist kiang ah thupina tangtawn in om hen. Amen.
english: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

paite: Himahleh unaute aw, ka hon ngen ahi, hanthawn thuhilhna ngaithei teitei un; na kiang uah thu tomchik ka gelh uhi.
english: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.

paite: I unaupa Timothi apawtsakta uh chih na thei un; ahong pai baihleh, amah toh nou ka hong mu ding uhi.
english: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.

paite: Nou hon heute tengteng leh misiangthoute tengteng chibai hon buksak un. Itali gam a mite'n chibai ahon buk uhi.
english: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.

paite: Na vek ua kiang ah hehpihna om hen, Amen.
english: Grace be with you all. Amen.
